criteria: Statewide or multi-county draw, recurs yearly, organizer has its own website. One entry per recurring tradition, never per year. Regions: NW, NE, Central, Tampa Bay (includes Sarasota and Manatee), SW (Lee, Collier, Charlotte), SE, Keys. Tags florida-icon, major-music-festival, tentpole and only-in-florida are editorial labels copied from wf_events only; entries added from outside wf_events carry none of them. confirmed_dated means a wf_events row with future or in-progress dates is linked via event_id; expected_undated means the next edition has no verified dates and event_id is null. Dates come only from wf_events and are never invented. source_url stays null until an organizer page has been read for that entry.
